current.title: Round 71 DELIVERED — the discipline & reliability round (0.71.0)
current.detail: Research-driven from the owner's four reference repos (karpathy-skills, alirezarezvani/claude-skills, cline, kilocode) after his 'smarter better much more capable and reliable' directive; the R71-c audit found the gaps concentrated in the model-facing layer, and this round closes them. (1) Prompt discipline: a new ENGINEERING DISCIPLINE section (4 karpathy principles with binary self-tests, [KNOWN]/[ASSUMED]/[UNKNOWN] tagging with never-code-on-an-UNKNOWN, 3-strike escalation, a 5-line red-flags table), task→verifiable-goal transforms in PLAN, verification receipts + 🟢🟡🔴 confidence tags + devil's advocate + anti-question-padding in COMMUNICATION, sub-agent scope/no-polling discipline; golden 20,156→23,665 bytes. (2) Tool reliability: read_file/run_command truncation markers carry the exact next call ('use offset=N to continue', spill-to-file recovery), edit_file consecutive-failure escalation (2nd re-read / 3rd change-approach / 5th refuse — NEW edit-streak.ts), owner denials say 'NOT a tool or system failure' with timeouts distinguished, provider errors classified into six classes (context_window_exceeded/auth/rate_limit/network/timeout/unknown) riding the 502 envelope + turn.error event additively, and context-overflow recovery (forced compaction + one retry, visible system line) on both turn paths. (3) Skills: 8 builtin descriptions rewritten trigger-rich ('Use when [phrasings]. NOT for [adjacent case]') + 4 new discipline builtins (focused-fix, zero-hallucination, self-eval, ship-gate — 12 total, INSERT OR IGNORE). Verification: 2287 root tests in 129 files, all green (agent-core 1385/66 files, frontend 890 unchanged, e2e 12), lint/typecheck clean, license audit CLEAN (134 deps, no dependency changes). The live gates (receipts in real replies, skill triggers on real phrasings, escalation ending flail loops, overflow recovery saving long sessions) await the owner's Windows field run.
